;
'use strict';
const sloppyObject:any=Object.freeze({x:1});
try { sloppyObject.x=2; console.log('program sloppy', sloppyObject.x); } catch { console.log('program strict'); }
function sloppyEmpty() {
  ;
  type Local=number;
  'use strict';
  const object:any=Object.freeze({x:1});
  try { object.x=2; console.log('function sloppy', object.x); } catch { console.log('function strict'); }
}
sloppyEmpty();
